items.summary: Grounded web search & research via Perplexity, keyless and pay-per-call over SELAT. items.summary: Backtest dollar-cost averaging (DCA) against lump-sum investing on any coin's real historical price data, using the free CoinGecko market_chart API (no API key required, up to 365 days of daily history).
